about.text: Iran's kashk: yoghurt churned with water to take off the butter, the defatted liquid boiled, drained in linen bags, salted, shaped and sun-dried into hard, protein-rich balls, which are later ground and soaked back into liquid kashk.

how.label: churn, boil, dry
how.text: In Iran, yoghurt is churned with water to remove the butter. The defatted drink is boiled, drained in linen bags, salted, shaped and sun-dried into hard, protein-rich kashk, which is later ground and rehydrated as liquid kashk.
